notes.title: Preparatory Patch for DLC
notes.notes:
Preparatory Patch for DLC

Preparatory Patch for DLC contains preparatory elements for activation and connection with DLC's. It also contains minor bug fixes and map adjustments.

What does the Preparatory Patch for DLC contain?
Preparation for DLC - This preparation is informational only and has no graphic design. Everything will be added in the future.

Map modifications - There have been some minor changes and modifications to the map. 

Changes - The end game has been simplified and the hitboxes of some of the slugs have been changed or removed completely.

Minor bug fixes - There were a couple of bugs in the game that this smell fixes.

You can look forward to the first DLC and free bonus maps coming soon.

In case of any problems, please contact us.

notes.title: Revenguard - Galactic Patch 1.0.97
notes.notes:
What does Galactic Patch 1.0.97 contain?

- Map changes
- Every object that can kill you now has inconspicuous red particles around it so you can tell what can kill you and what can't.

- Graphical changes to widgets
- All text buttons for the widgets listed are now red with a black border. So that you can distinguish the button from the text. Changes have been made in the following widgets: Stats Widget, Controller Settings Widget, Options Widget. The other buttons in the game have not been changed.

- Removed things
- Darkening in caves has been removed due to issues. It will be added back in the next patch 1.1.
- Dramatic song on two slugs after the first cave, has been removed due to an issue. It will not be added back in the next patch 1.1.
- Some items on the map have been removed due to issues. They will not be added back in the next patch 1.1.

- Bug fixes
- Several small bugs have been fixed in the game. 

In case of any problems, please contact us.

notes.title: Revenguard - Galactic Patch 1.0.95
notes.notes:
What does Galactic Patch 1.0.95 contain?

- Fix moveing animation in main menu
The menu is made so that the forest spawns over the camera. Since Galactic Patch 1.0.79 this spawning has stopped working.

- Map changes
Reduced spawn rate of falling stalactites from 2-6s to 4-10s.
Jumps on the entire map have been lightened.

- Increased the amount of checkpoints on the map.
Classic mode: from 9 to 14
Hard mode: from 5 to 8
Extreme mode: left without checkpoints (no adjustments)

- Added background music
Added 3 background songs that are randomly played.

notes.title: Revenguard Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are happy to announce that the official release date of Revenguard on Steam is today, August 25, 2023!

We are very excited to finally announce the official release date of our Revenguard game. Our team has been working hard to make the game the best it can be. The game contains a very rich story that will be developed in the next installments of the Revenguard series.

How to get free access to Revenguard?
If you are a content creator or manage to find us while promoting our Revenguard game, we are able to give you free access. We are a start-up development team focused on developing computer games. Any promotion of our products would help us a lot and improve our overall results in development and beyond. The Revenguard game would provide content for your business and would help us greatly. If you are interested, we would love to work with you. Contact us at this email address: galacticgames.business@gmail.com

For more information on the release, please visit our Discord server and our social media channels such as Instagram and TikTok.

Have a great galactic day!

- Galactic Games Team
